name: DownloadFile
description: Downloads a file from Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and download files from SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to download (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.pdf).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the file content (as Base64 or byte array) and metadata such as file name, size, and URL.
